architecture.description: Python package entry point with module-based MCP server, configurable stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP transports, and Immich REST API access.

patterns.pattern: Module-based package with thin entry point

outbound.interface: Immich REST API via OpenAPI spec

design-decisions.decision: Start with a single-file entry point to iterate quickly.
Allow MCP transport/host/port configuration via environment variables for tests and containers.
Refactor into a module-based package while keeping main.py as a thin entry point.

security.note: Auth and network handling introduced for Immich API access; ensure secrets are not logged and TLS is required.
OpenAPI tools are filtered by permission metadata and write probes to reduce unauthorized exposure; avoid logging secrets.
Security-related item 61 archived as DONE; mitigation recorded in implementation results.

feature.title: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
feature.description: Added config-driven Immich HTTP handling, OpenAPI spec fetch, and core MCP tools (ping, server info/version, current user).

feature.title: Filter MCP tools by API key permissions
feature.description: Added capability discovery and conditional tool registration; provided a tool access report for visibility into blocked tools.

feature.title: Add integration test using .env_test credentials
feature.description: Added integration tests that load env files and assert tool exposure matches Immich permission probes.

feature.title: Update README to reflect current project usage and status
feature.description: Updated README to list current tools, configuration, and integration test setup aligned with the implemented MCP server.

feature.title: Add Dockerfile and docker-compose for local usage
feature.description: Added Dockerfile, docker-compose configuration, and a .dockerignore to keep secrets out of images.

feature.title: Add env-driven MCP server transport configuration
feature.description: Added MCP transport configuration via environment variables and updated MCP client tests to run against an SSE server process.

feature.title: Expose MCP ports in docker-compose
feature.description: Published the MCP port via docker-compose and documented the MCP transport and port configuration for containers.

feature.title: Expose Immich OpenAPI endpoints as MCP tools with permission filtering
feature.description: Generated MCP tools for OpenAPI operations with auth/admin/write filtering and added tests for write-tool exposure.

feature.title: Stop exposing OpenAPI summary/path tools
feature.description: Removed OpenAPI summary/path tools from MCP registration and updated tests to match.

feature.title: Expose OpenAPI parameter schemas for MCP tools
feature.description: OpenAPI tool generation now exposes explicit parameter fields and updated tests validate schema presence.

feature.title: Add MCP usage guide with server instructions and workflow examples
feature.description: Added server instructions, a usage guide resource, and workflow prompts to improve tool discovery.

feature.title: Enrich OpenAPI tool descriptions with parameter summaries and response hints
feature.description: OpenAPI tool descriptions now include required parameter summaries, short examples, and response schema hints.

feature.title: Default write probe to /api/assets POST
feature.description: Defaulted the write probe to POST /api/assets, documented the behavior, and added a unit test for default settings.

feature.title: Split main.py into modules
feature.description: Split main.py into a package with focused modules while keeping a thin entry point.

feature.title: Docker container fails to import claw2immich package
feature.description: Added the package and docs to the image and set PYTHONPATH so main.py can import claw2immich during container startup.

feature.title: Expand initialize instructions with workflows, tool groups, and examples
feature.description: Expanded server initialize instructions with externalDomain guidance, workflow groups, and an example string; updated usage guide and README to align.

feature.title: Blocked_tools reason too generic for capability errors
feature.description: Capability probe errors now include HTTP status or network error details in blocked tool reasons; added unit tests covering 403, 500, and timeout-style failures.

feature.title: Fetch OpenAPI spec for server version
feature.description: OpenAPI spec fetch now checks server health, reads version, and loads the versioned spec from GitHub with unit coverage.

feature.title: searchAssets/searchSmart missing and 400 errors in tool_access_report
feature.description: Read-only POST endpoints are no longer blocked by write probes; write probe 400s are treated as validation errors, and tool_access_report uses permission hints to gate write tools.

feature.title: Add searchAssets/searchSmart guidance to prompts
feature.description: Added prompts guiding searchAssets/searchSmart usage with tool selection by description and inputSchema hints.

feature.title: Dynamic externalDomain in initialize instructions
feature.description: Initialize instructions now inject the resolved externalDomain when available, with a fallback hint when missing.

feature.title: Add configuration profiles for permission-based tool access levels
feature.description: Implemented configuration profiles (read_only, read_write, full_scope) with env-based loading via IMMICH_PROFILE, profile-aware tool filtering, and comprehensive documentation.

feature.title: _request() silently swallows exceptions into error dicts
feature.description: Defined exception hierarchy (ImmichAPIError, ImmichNetworkError, ImmichConfigError); updated _request() to raise exceptions; updated all callers with proper error handling and comprehensive unit tests.

feature.title: Dockerfile uses pip instead of uv, ignores lockfile
feature.description: Installed uv in the Docker image; replaced hardcoded pip install with uv sync --frozen to use lockfile; verified container builds and starts correctly.

feature.title: Unit test coverage gaps — config, http_client, mcp_app, prompts at 0%
feature.description: Created test_config.py (19 tests), test_mcp_app.py (8 tests), test_prompts.py (3 tests) with comprehensive coverage for config validation, port ranges, profile selection, and external domain resolution.

feature.title: Duplicate tool-name deduplication logic in tooling.py
feature.description: Extracted _deduplicate_name() helper function to replace duplicate code blocks in _openapi_tool_access and _register_openapi_tools; added 4 unit tests.

feature.title: Add structured logging for observability
feature.description: Added logging.getLogger() to all claw2immich modules; wired MCP_LOG_LEVEL for log level configuration; added key event logging for startup, capability discovery, and HTTP errors.

feature.title: Add GitHub Actions CI pipeline
feature.description: Created .github/workflows/ci.yml workflow with Python 3.12 setup, pytest coverage reporting, and CI badge added to README.

feature.title: No port range validation in config.py
feature.description: Added port range check (0 or 1-65535) in get_mcp_settings() with descriptive error; added 5 unit tests covering boundary values.

feature.title: _permission_is_read() does not handle None permission — over-blocks POST endpoints
feature.description: Updated write operation detection to not block endpoints when permission metadata is absent; added comprehensive unit tests for all permission filtering scenarios.

feature.title: Nested $ref schemas not resolved recursively in openapi.py
feature.description: Updated _resolve_schema() with recursive resolution, cycle detection via seen set, and 10-level depth limit; added 8 comprehensive unit tests.

feature.title: Warn when credentials are sent over plain HTTP
feature.description: Added HTTP warning check in _request() when credentials are present; emits logger.warning with suppression flag IMMICH_ALLOW_HTTP; added 3 unit tests.

feature.title: Resolve request body $ref schemas into individual typed parameters
feature.description: Added _operation_request_body_field_specs() to resolve $ref schemas; updated tool generation to expose individual body_* parameters with types and required flags; maintained backward compatibility.

feature.title: Replace deprecated get_server_info with getServerVersion
feature.description: Removed get_server_info function; getServerVersion via /api/server/version remains as the replacement.

feature.title: Add description text to all 8 MCP prompts
feature.description: Added description parameter to all 8 @mcp.prompt() decorators with action-oriented descriptions matching existing title style.

feature.title: Embed workflow hints directly in server instructions instead of relying on resources
feature.description: Embedded URL patterns, parameter naming conventions, search workflow hints, and profile info directly into server instructions while keeping usage guide available as fallback.

feature.title: Add prompt example for multi-person image search using immich_searchassets
feature.description: Added prompt_search_multiple_people to prompts.py with clear guidance on using body_personIds as an array for AND logic when searching for images with multiple people. The prompt text explicitly explains the difference between AND logic (array of person IDs in one call) and OR logic (separate searches). Updated test_prompts.py to expect 9 prompts instead of 8. All tests pass successfully.

feature.title: Tests fail during collection in CI due to missing environment configuration
feature.description: Root cause was missing build-system configuration and incomplete package discovery in pyproject.toml. The claw2immich package was not being installed in editable mode due to setuptools detecting multiple top-level packages (claw2immich and helper in flat layout). Fixed by: (1) Adding [build-system] with setuptools backend, (2) Configuring [tool.setuptools.packages.find] to explicitly include only claw2immich and exclude helper/tests/docs, (3) Adding [tool.setuptools] py-modules = ["main"] to make main.py importable. Tests now collect without errors: 87 tests pass with `uv sync --frozen` (CI approach) and local editable installs. No environment variables needed for test collection.

feature.title: Build and publish Docker images to GitHub Container Registry
feature.description: Created build-docker.yml workflow with comprehensive Docker image build and push logic: (1) Triggers on push to main/develop, PRs to main, and tags matching v*; (2) Uses docker/setup-buildx-action@v3 for multi-architecture builds (linux/amd64, linux/arm64); (3) Authenticates to GHCR with GitHub token (permissions.packages: write) and skips auth for PRs; (4) Uses docker/metadata-action to automatically generate tags: latest (main), develop (develop branch), semver versions, and commit SHA; (5) Cache optimization with GitHub Actions cache backend. Updated README.md with section on pulling pre-built images from GHCR with examples for latest, develop, specific versions, and different transport modes/profiles. Workflow properly depends on the existing CI pipeline (item 34) without explicit job dependency since tests run on the same branch conditions.

feature.title: Regression: web_url missing in immich_searchassets and immich_searchsmart item results
feature.description: Two root causes found. (1) Original fix enabled POST search decoration via _should_decorate_response() — correct but insufficient. (2) Immich search responses use a nested section structure {"assets": {"total": N, "items": [...]}, "albums": {"total": N, "items": [...]}} where section values are dicts, not flat lists. _extract_decoratable_array() only checked for isinstance(response[field], list), never detecting these nested sections. Fixed by adding a "sections" wrapper type: _extract_decoratable_array() now detects dict sections with inner "items" lists, and _decorate_response() iterates over all search sections (assets, albums, people, places) decorating each item. Module-level constants _ARRAY_FIELD_NAMES and _SEARCH_SECTION_KEYS replace duplicated inline tuples. Added 8 new tests covering nested section decoration, metadata preservation, empty sections, and person UUID safety within search results.

feature.title: Refactor downloadAsset delivery for MCP payload limits (REST endpoint vs temporary Immich link)
feature.description: Delivery strategy toggle implemented via IMMICH_DOWNLOAD_ASSET_DELIVERY (inline_base64 default, immich_link alternative). Bug found in immich_link mode: download_url was built from config['base_url'] (internal/Docker URL like http://immich:2283) instead of the client-reachable external domain. Fixed by using get_external_domain() with fallback to config['base_url']. Added test verifying external domain preference when IMMICH_EXTERNAL_DOMAIN is set. Updated existing immich_link test to explicitly patch get_external_domain(return_value=None) for the internal-URL-fallback case.

feature.title: Native binary endpoints return corrupted payload via UTF-8/JSON serialization (immich_downloadasset, immich_viewasset)
feature.description: Confirmed byte corruption risk at server serialization boundaries rather than Immich source bytes. Fixed by making non-text _request responses JSON-safe (base64 wrapper with metadata) and by removing raw-byte payload emission from downloadAsset; binary request mode now returns base64 plus warning/metadata. Added regression tests for binary wrapping in both http_client and downloadAsset paths.

feature.title: Make MCP prompts concrete with explicit tool names and argument templates
feature.description: Refactored prompt messages from discovery-first wording to direct tool invocation guidance with explicit tool names and copy-ready argument patterns. Updated search, smart-search, get-image, person/location, upload, share, and download prompt texts plus usage-guide workflows for consistency.

feature.title: Asset web_url may use person UUID instead of asset UUID for person-tagged assets
feature.description: URL-type-aware _extract_entity_id() precedence was correctly implemented previously (asset type → only assetId/id, never personId). However, the fix was inert for search results because item 52's nested-section bug prevented decoration from reaching individual items at all. With item 52 now fixed (_extract_decoratable_array handles nested dict sections), the person-UUID-safe extraction is exercised end-to-end. Added new regression tests: (1) test_decorate_response_search_person_uuid_not_leaked — asset with nested people array must use asset UUID, not person UUID; (2) test_decorate_response_search_asset_with_personid_field — asset with stray personId field still gets /photos/{asset-id}. Both tests operate on realistic nested search response shapes.

feature.title: Add helper script to list .env files and run Smart Search with direct JSON output
feature.description: Implemented helper/smart_search_cli.py with CLI options to list available .env files and execute POST /api/search/smart using selected env credentials. Script prints direct JSON output to stdout and returns non-zero exit codes for missing args, missing env file, config/auth errors, and request failures. Added focused tests for env listing/parsing, argument validation, success path, and HTTP error handling.

feature.title: Nested person objects may be decorated with /photos/{id} instead of /people/{id}
feature.description: Item 59 was effectively resolved by item 58's single-entity precedence fix. Added regression tests proving nested people objects in asset-detail payloads no longer get decorated as `/photos/{person-id}` and that top-level asset URL remains correct.

feature.title: downloadAsset output parameter is misleading because binary request still returns base64
feature.description: Full-suite regression detected on 2026-02-19: `tests/test_download_asset.py::test_download_asset_binary_mode` fails with `KeyError: 'asset_id'`. Failure path shows `download_asset()` currently validates `output` with `if mode not in ("base64")`, rejecting `output="binary"` and returning an error payload (without `asset_id`) instead of the expected MCP-safe base64 response. Item moved back to IN_PROGRESS for corrective implementation.

feature.title: downloadAsset should return short-lived shared link instead of payload data when API supports it
feature.description: Implemented shared-link-first delivery for `downloadAsset` in `shared_link` and `immich_link` modes. The tool now attempts Immich shared-link creation (`/api/shared-links/createSharedLink` and fallback `/api/shared-links`) with 30-minute TTL and returns link-only metadata (no inline file payload). `shared_link` mode now fails clearly when creation is unavailable; `immich_link` mode falls back to direct authenticated Immich link. Added config support for `IMMICH_DOWNLOAD_ASSET_DELIVERY=shared_link`, plus tests for success/failure/fallback paths.

feature.title: Integration test: verify web_url accessibility for all URL types (items 46–49)
feature.description: Executed full test workflow (`uv run pytest tests/ -v`) and initially observed 2 failures in tests/test_integration_url_access.py: (1) test_asset_web_url_accessible failed on Immich instances returning 404 for GET /api/assets, (2) test_album_web_url_accessible detected incorrect /photos/{id} decoration for album list entries containing only generic id fields. Failure mapping: primary match to item 50 (this integration suite), with root-cause code path in claw2immich/tooling.py. Fixes applied: added fallback in asset integration test to POST /api/search/assets when GET /api/assets is unavailable; improved _detect_response_type() album inference using album-specific fields (albumName, albumThumbnailAssetId, sharedLinkId, isActivityEnabled); added unit regressions for album-name inference. Re-ran full suite: 173 passed, 11 skipped, 0 failed.

feature.title: Add downloadAsset tool with JSON-safe base64 and configurable link delivery
feature.description: Item 51 is implemented and aligned with item 53 strategy: downloadAsset now returns JSON-safe base64 payloads for MCP transport, accepts binary request mode without emitting raw bytes, and supports delivery strategy selection via IMMICH_DOWNLOAD_ASSET_DELIVERY (`inline_base64` or `immich_link`). Tests were extended for delivery mode config, link mode, and binary-safe behavior.

feature.title: getassetinfo: Top-level asset misses web_url while nested people are decorated
feature.description: Root cause confirmed in `_decorate_response`: array extraction ran before single-entity decoration and interpreted nested `people[]` in asset detail responses as wrapped top-level arrays. Added early-return logic for non-`array` url types so single-entity endpoints decorate the top-level dict first. This restores `web_url` on `immich_getassetinfo` asset responses.

feature.title: Person objects decorated with /photos/{id} instead of /people/{id} URLs
feature.description: The heuristic fix for person-object type detection was already partially in place (birthDate, thumbnailPath). During implementation, two additional Immich-exclusive person fields were identified and added to the heuristic check: isHidden (a boolean always present on person objects, never on assets) and faces (array field returned in detailed person responses). The final detection order in _detect_response_type() is: explicit type field (PERSON/IMAGE/etc.) → dedicated ID fields (personId, albumId, placeId) → person-specific structural fields (birthDate, thumbnailPath, isHidden, faces) → fallback to asset if "id" present. Added 3 new tests: test_detect_response_type_person_with_ishidden, test_detect_response_type_person_with_faces, and test_decorate_response_person_with_ishidden_field. All 77 url-decoration tests pass; full suite: 159 passed, 12 skipped, 3 pre-existing MCP-client failures (Connection refused — require live Immich server, unrelated to this item).

feature.title: URL decorator not applied to search endpoints (e.g., immich_searchassets) and bulk array responses
feature.description: Extended _should_decorate_response() to detect all relevant search, browse, and collection endpoints (/search/*, /cine, /explore, /memories, /map, /duplicates, /statistics, /timelines, and bulk endpoints /assets, /albums, /people, /places). Added _extract_decoratable_array() helper to detect and extract decoratable arrays from nested response structures (supports results, data, items, assets, albums, people, places, photos, memories, timelines, statistics wrapper fields). Updated _decorate_response() to handle both direct arrays and wrapped arrays, preserving original response structure while decorating items. Added 22 comprehensive tests covering wrapped arrays (results, data, assets, items fields), paginated responses, endpoint detection for all known array endpoints, and metadata preservation in wrapped responses. All 160 tests pass with no regressions.

feature.title: Extend URL decoration in _decorate_response to handle response arrays with IMAGE/VIDEO type fields
feature.description: Extended _should_decorate_response() to detect array endpoints (/search/*, /assets, /albums, /people, /places) and return url_type='array' for auto-detection. Added new _detect_response_type() helper function to identify URL type based on "type": "IMAGE"/"VIDEO"/"MEMORY"/"ALBUM"/"PERSON"/"PLACE" fields or ID field names. Created _decorate_single_item() helper to process individual items with proper type detection and ID extraction. Enhanced _decorate_response() to handle both single objects and arrays of items, applying decoration to each array element while preserving structure. Added 23 new comprehensive tests covering array responses with IMAGE/VIDEO types, mixed-type arrays, empty arrays, items without IDs, non-dict items, and full backward compatibility verification. All 138 tests pass with no regressions.

feature.title: Add IMMICH_EXTERNAL_DOMAIN parameter to docker-compose and include externalDomain-based URLs in tool responses
feature.description: Implemented configurable IMMICH_EXTERNAL_DOMAIN support with automatic URL decoration in tool responses. Added get_external_domain() to config.py for reading env var (with validation). Created helper functions for detecting decoratable endpoints and extracting IDs. Updated _register_openapi_tools to pass external_domain to _make_tool and decorate asset/album/person/place responses with web_url field. Updated mcp_app.py to check configured domain first before discovering from server. Updated constants.py build_server_instructions to document the new env var. Updated docker-compose.yaml with commented example. Added 45+ test cases covering config, URL detection, ID extraction, and response decoration. Updated README and usage-guide.md documentation. All code passes syntax validation.

utility.title: Helper utilities for development and maintenance
utility.description: Standalone scripts for MCP tool access reporting, item archival automation, and development workflows.

lessons-learned.note: Keep architecture notes and file mappings current after refactors to prevent drift and stale XML structure.
Regular update scans verify XMLs match codebase reality and catch orphaned items or new features; helper utilities don't need feature tracking as they're dev-only tools.
